title: Topographic Maps of East Timor (TMET)
description:
This is an old topographic map dataset for East Timur created with UNTAET. 

JICA and UNTAET agreed that the digital topographic maps and digital data for GIS to be prepared by the Study on Urgent Establishment of Topographic Mapping East Timor will be open to the pubic use. 

However, this repository is not currently intended for public release of the data.
